headlines.text: That Saturday in 2026, Hazuki vs. Persephone met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 7.13 ? a well-worked match.
It was 2026 when Dralistico, Guevara & Rush kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 5.19.
On this day in 2026, Castagnoli, Moxley & PAC vs. Infantry & Moriarty met for the very first time on Collision, rated 6.46.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2026, when Juice Robinson chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a genuine milestone, facing Clark Connors vs. Juice Robinson on Collision, rated 5.60 in a hard-fought men's division clash.

Flash back to 2026, when the AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Divine Dominion vs. TayJay went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 5.48. For TayJay, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
